records.title: On designing with code
records.summary: A small observation on computational workflows.
records.body: A model is more useful when its logic is as legible as its geometry. The interesting part is not just automating shapes—it is making design decisions inspectable.

records.title: Introducing our visual research archive

records.body: We are assembling a growing archive of geometric experiments, tools and material research. More soon.

records.title: Geometry as a design language
records.summary: Why computational systems matter beyond form-making.
records.body:
## Beyond the image

Computational design is not simply a way to produce complex shapes. It is a way to describe relationships, dependencies and constraints.

## A readable design process

When the model can explain itself, we gain a new kind of design material: one that can be interrogated, adapted and shared.

- Geometry
- Metadata
- Relationships
- Operations

Each becomes part of a continuous working system.
